title: Top 100 Stata command-template requirements
objective: Each ranked command group is covered by a declared direct-primitive policy or one or more audited state-compatible templates. User-written commands require maintainer-guide mechanics before researcher-code examples may be promoted. Guide mechanics remain a noncompeting companion layer.

ranking_contract.ranking_basis: editorial coverage priority, not universal command-frequency telemetry
ranking_contract.tie_rule: source rank, then normalized primary command, then group_id
ranking_contract.observed_usage_policy: Corpus occurrences are supporting evidence in a separate ledger, not the rank denominator.

complexity_weighted_sufficiency.simple_command_rule: One guide mechanic is sufficient only when it fully represents one bounded command state and no second material state is required.
complexity_weighted_sufficiency.complex_command_rule: Require multiple variants when input state, command grammar, estimator or inference choice, weight or support, persistence, or downstream output state changes.
complexity_weighted_sufficiency.duplicate_rule: Spelling, abbreviation, variable-name, or cosmetic formatting changes alone are not material variants.
complexity_weighted_sufficiency.verification_rule: Each required variant is a declared material state contract; candidate promotion independently screens contamination, duplicate code, provenance, runtime, and selector evidence.

promotion_policy.forbidden_claim: A legacy label or guide-only mechanics record is not an audited auto-selectable template.

guide_absorption_policy.rule: For every required variant, retain at least one bounded official-manual or maintainer-guide mechanics atom. Also retain a contract-adjacent guide variant only when it changes observable input state, output state, estimator, inference, weight, support, persistence, or output ownership.
exclude: whole-guide copies or long narrative examples
duplicate examples with the same executable state transition
guide-supplied sample, estimand, fixed-effect, cluster, instrument, sheet-placement, or interpretation decisions
source_requirements: official URL and release or package version when available
raw source and local snapshot SHA-256
exact page, section, or line span
six-field input profile and three-field state signature

retrieval_tiers.guide_mechanics: A noncompeting companion layer for syntax, options, and state mechanics; never auto-selectable by itself.
retrieval_tiers.research_usage: A separately matched deposited-paper or other independent researcher-code example; it cannot replace command authority.
retrieval_tiers.implementation: Use an audited exact usage template when compatible, otherwise a guide-informed fallback that supplies no unresolved research decision.
